finding.expected: Resolve the applicable prior semantic review for both REMEDIATION and REPAIR correction tips through exact immutable correction continuity, preserving parent RUN, embedded review/finding identity, reviewed/failed SHA binding, and fail-closed ambiguity. A valid REPAIR of a failed REMEDIATION with its exact DELTA review must reduce deterministically rather than becoming MALFORMED_CANONICAL_STATE merely because the tip family is REPAIR. Add a focused regression for that lineage without restoring TASK-wide finding-id search, retry, reroute, or new authority.
finding.issue: RUN-086-003 removes the TASK-wide finding-id scan for REMEDIATION tips, but the replacement binds prior_review only when tip.family is REMEDIATION. A valid REPAIR continuation can also require DELTA review, including repair of a failed REMEDIATION. In that case the canonical tip family is REPAIR and review.prior_finding_id is non-null, so the current code leaves prior_review as None and rejects the exact correction lineage as malformed/BLOCKED. The added regression exercises only a REMEDIATION chain and therefore does not establish the correction-family-complete behavior required by the F4 expectation and TASK-086 lineage-driven semantics.
